steps.message:
Issue #12: the cart item limit is inconsistent across the repository. Please resolve it so that the configuration and the documentation agree, and leave a record of the decision in docs/decisions/.

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

arguments.command: git log --stat -8 --format='%h %ad %s%n%b' && grep -rniE "cart.*(limit|max)|(limit|max).*cart|\b(50|100)\b" --exclude-dir=.git . | head -50; ls docs docs/decisions; gh issue view 12 --comments

# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.reasoning_content: The config and design doc both say 100, and only ADR 0007 says 60, based on load figures the 2026-09 test superseded. I'll leave the ADR as evidence and record the decision instead.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100 items per cart
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md]
---
Two values were found. ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) set 60 items because the 2024-08 load test showed p99 reservation latency of 3.9 s at 80 lines and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. The commit of 2026-09-15 raised config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md to 100, citing the 2026-09 load test, which was run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched) and measured 0.9 s at 100 lines (1.7 s at 150). The ADR's premise, the old service's latency, no longer holds, so its limit of 60 loses its support. 100 is backed by current measurements under the timeout, and it only loosens the limit, so no existing customer promise is broken. config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md already state 100. ADR 0007 is left unedited as a historical record and is superseded by this decision.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: record decision on cart item limit (100)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now settled at **100**. The configuration and design doc already said 100, so I changed neither.

- **Conflict:** the only disagreement was ADR 0007, which says 60.
- **Why 60 existed:** the 2024-08 load test showed 3.9 s p99 at 80 lines and 7.2 s at 100, against the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
- **Why 100 wins:** the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01. The 2026-09 load test measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, and 1.7 s even at 150. The old latency numbers no longer apply, so 60 has lost its support.
- **Customer impact:** raising the limit doesn't break anything customers were promised, so I didn't label the issue `needs-decision`.
- **ADR 0007:** left unedited, since it's a record of what was decided at the time.
- **Decision record:** `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md`, committed as 3d507d6. I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.
